response.chief_complaint_evolution: Patient reported left calf swelling, warmth, and tenderness accompanied by pain on dorsiflexion, arising after a prolonged 14-hour bus trip.

key_findings_timeline.finding: Left calf swollen, warm and tender after a 14-hour bus journey from Mombasa, pain on dorsiflexion.

response.end_state_clinical_picture: Clinical presentation is highly suspicious for deep vein thrombosis (DVT) of the left lower extremity due to prolonged immobilization (14-hour travel) combined with classic physical exam signs (swelling, warmth, tenderness, pain on dorsiflexion). Objective diagnostic evaluation is required.
response.pending_vs_confirmed: Confirmed: Physical signs of left calf swelling, warmth, tenderness, and pain on dorsiflexion following prolonged travel. Pending: Objective diagnostic confirmation (such as a venous duplex ultrasound or D-dimer testing), as no objective imaging or lab results have been reported yet.
